name: IBPS PO
tagline: Common recruitment for Probationary Officers / Management Trainees in public sector banks

overview.about: IBPS conducts the Common Recruitment Process (CRP PO/MT) for participating public sector banks. Selection is through Prelims, Mains (objective + descriptive) and an interview; final allotment uses Mains and interview marks in an 80 : 20 ratio.
eligibility: Graduation in any discipline; mark sheet/degree must be held by the date given in the notification
Age 20–30 years (e.g. born between 02.07.1995 and 01.07.2005 for the 2025 cycle); relaxation: SC/ST 5 yrs, OBC-NCL 3 yrs, PwBD 10 yrs, ex-servicemen 5 yrs
Indian citizen (or other categories as defined)
Computer literacy and knowledge of the official language of the state are desirable

pattern.note: Sectional + overall cut-off; −0.25 per wrong answer
Minimum 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD); final = Mains 80 : Interview 20

cards.title: Sectional cut-offs everywhere
cards.body: Unlike SBI PO Prelims, IBPS PO applies **sectional and overall cut-offs** in both Prelims and Mains. A brilliant Quant score cannot rescue a weak English score. Your plan must keep every section safely above its cut-off.

cards.title: Final merit
points: Mains (out of 225) and Interview (out of 100) are combined 80 : 20

cards.title: GA: biggest marks per minute
cards.body: In the 2025 pattern GA gives **50 marks in 25 minutes**, and some questions carry 2 marks. Six months of current affairs plus static banking (this core syllabus) is the highest-return preparation for Mains.

cards.title: Prelims order
cards.body: English first is common because it is the section most people find hardest to time well; but the best order is the one you have tested in at least 10 full mocks. Never change it on exam day.

cards.title: Bank allotment
cards.body: After the final merit list, IBPS allots candidates to participating banks based on **merit and the preference order** you give. A provisional allotment list is published; reserve lists may follow.

cards.q: A candidate scores 135/225 in Mains and 50/100 in the interview. Final score?
In the revised (2025) IBPS PO Mains, the General/Economy/Banking Awareness section has:
cards.explain: The 2025 notification lists 35 questions for 50 marks in 25 minutes.

cards.title: Format
cards.body: **2 questions, 25 marks, 30 minutes**, typed in English, right after the objective test. One essay and one letter is the usual combination. It is evaluated only for candidates who clear the objective cut-offs.

cards.title: Formal letter layout
points: Salutation → body (3 short paras) → complimentary close

cards.title: Essay in 250 words
points: Intro with one fact or definition
Two body paragraphs: opportunities and challenges

cards.title: Time split
cards.body: Spend about **2 minutes planning** each answer (jot 4–5 points), 11 minutes typing, and the last 2 minutes checking spelling and word count. Unfinished answers lose more marks than slightly shorter ones.

cards.title: Topics to prepare
cards.body: Public sector bank consolidation, UPI and digital rupee, cyber fraud, MSME credit, financial literacy, climate finance, AI in banking, women-led development. Keep 3 facts ready for each.

cards.q: The IBPS PO descriptive paper consists of:
cards.explain: Essay and letter writing: 2 questions for 25 marks in 30 minutes.

cards.q: Which element is NOT part of a standard formal letter?
cards.explain: Hashtags belong to social media, not formal letters.

cards.title: What the panel checks
cards.body: Communication, clarity of thought, knowledge of banking and the economy, awareness of your own background, and attitude to rural postings and transfers. The interview is **100 marks**, weighted **20%** of the final score.

cards.title: Must-prepare questions
cards.body: Introduce yourself; why banking; why leave your current job (if any); your graduation subject; your hometown's economy; current repo rate and MPC stance; one recent scheme; how you would handle an angry customer.

cards.title: Documents & DAF
cards.body: Panels often build questions from your application form. Revise every hobby and achievement you listed. Carry all original documents in the order given in the call letter.

cards.title: Qualifying marks
cards.body: You must score at least **40%** (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) in the interview to be considered for the final merit, regardless of your Mains score.

cards.q: What weight does the IBPS PO interview carry in the final merit?
cards.explain: Mains and interview are combined in the ratio 80 : 20.
